items.title: Over £10 million in support approved since Fisheries and Seafood Scheme reopened
items.content_text: Since reopening on 13 April 2026, over £10 million in funding has been approved through the Fisheries and Seafood Scheme (FaSS). Around 60% of approved applications are from the Small Scale Coastal Fleet (SSCF).
